single_person_custody.reason: Trustworthy co-stewards are added when they actually exist; the project does not manufacture false redundancy.

invariants: No project role is encoded into AccountID or end-user protocol authority.
Adding/removing project stewards never requires end-user identity migration.
Existing open-source/protocol rights remain usable if canonical stewardship is captured or disappears.
legal_operational_note: SeedLife/lonunjie is protocol/source steward only for roles it actually controls; optional downstream providers/users/organizations operate their own roles and obligations.
